name: DGV (Database of Genomic Variants)
scope: Curated catalogue of structural variation from healthy-control studies; downloadable tab-delimited files for hg18, hg19 and hg38, plus supporting and filtered variant sets.
mapping_methods: Intervals; studies with newer assemblies are not mapped back to older builds.

quantitative.summary: Observed gain/loss counts and sample sizes per variant region.

licence.name: TCAG Notice and Disclaimer of Database Use (data provided 'AS IS'; appropriate acknowledgement required; cite MacDonald et al. 2013, NAR, PMID 24174537)
licence.redistribution: No redistribution licence is stated. Use is permitted subject to the disclaimer and acknowledgement; this repository does not redistribute the data (git-ignored).

coverage_limitations: Array/short-read era studies dominate; breakpoint resolution is limited

reuse_decision.rationale: Complements gnomAD-SV with older, study-level control CNVs and structural variants. The 364 MB GRCh38 release (2025-12-01) is fetched, size-verified (the site publishes no checksum) and structurally validated; used under the TCAG disclaimer with acknowledgement (cite MacDonald et al. 2013) and not redistributed.

status.notes: Download links extracted from the downloads page HTML.

evidence_profile.biological_context: Variants reported by studies of healthy-control cohorts. Each study used its own platform and calling method, so breakpoints and frequencies are study-specific.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Observational calls with per-study sample sizes. Frequencies are not harmonised across studies, and overlapping calls from different studies can describe one event.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: None. DGV records intervals and types seen in controls and does not describe mechanisms.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: Observation in control cohorts is evidence that a CNV or SV is compatible with absence of overt disease in those individuals, weakened by incomplete phenotyping, reduced penetrance and late onset.
evidence_profile.absence_means: Not catalogued means not reported in these studies; it does not make a CNV rare, de novo or pathogenic.

overlaps_with_sources.note: independent population SV catalogues of different design; compare frequencies, do not pool
